title: Clean two hidden deposits behind an overhanging toilet rim
instruction: Use the angled brush to remove both brown marks from the underside of the rim. Lower the head through the opening and reach behind the ceramic lip. Return the brush upright.
context: Cleaning the recessed underside requires inserting a tool through a narrower opening, sweeping behind the lip with bristle contact and withdrawing without striking the fixture.
setup: Bench-scale vitreous-china bowl, 386 × 304 mm outer rim, 134 mm above the tabletop. Two deposits on the downward-facing underside. Two wall marks are diagnostic only. Bent toilet brush with a 30 mm head and 31 mm offset on its holder.
scoring: Full score when both hidden marks are at least 92% removed and the brush is upright, supported and released in the stand. Otherwise score 0.40 times the sum of both hidden cleaned fractions. Exposed-wall scrubbing earns no credit.
fidelity: Rigid contact-enabled angled brush and static concave bowl mesh. Two-sided finger contacts and positive bristle-to-ceramic impulse gate swept deposition. Bristle flex and cleaning chemistry are simplified.
scores: Revised contact-based task awaits scripted and Dream-1 runs. Previous evidence uses an earlier scorer.
